assertions.source: reaching σ(c_4)/|c_4|<1 needs (σ_R/|c_4|u^4)²≈1.01e+4 independent physical anchors (> cap 1000); only one neutron Q-value exists.

description: THE UNIFYING RESULT for the c_k campaign. The c_k are read off R(u)=Q_β/(Q_A·cos)=∏(1+c_k·u^k) with u=b·ℏ_q²≈0.008517; the only noisy input is the measured neutron Q_β (σ_R≈6e-7, AME). Since ∂lnR/∂c_k≈u^k, the extracted uncertainty is σ(c_k)=σ_R/u^k, which explodes as u^k underflows (u^3≈σ_R, u^4≈5.3e-9≪σ_R). Only c_2 (σ/|c|~0.8%) and c_3 (~48%, marginal) are data-determined (k_max=3); c_4..c_10 have σ(c_k)/|c_k|≫1 (c_10's '1e8' has σ~1e14) — the erratic free rungs, derived. Multi-anchor does NOT rescue this (≈1e4 independent physical anchors needed; only one neutron Q-value exists), superseding the earlier multi-anchor-unblock framing. ⇒ the c_k≥4 keystone is necessarily a canonical framework derivation, not an extraction. Information bound (formalize-first), diagnostic-only; tiers governed by the c_k/d_k registry.
